sections.Profile:
See Saw , released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in September 1970, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Ted Zale, with artwork by Christian Marche. It features a fun amusement park theme with distinctive gameplay mechanics including two flippers, multiple standup targets, and a challenging playfield design that rewards players with multipliers and bonuses.
